title: Physical Layer
markdown:
The **Physical Layer** (Layer 1) coordinates the functions required to transmit a raw stream of bits over a physical medium.

### Primary Responsibilities

- **Bit Transmission** — Moves individual bits from one node (hop) to the next.
- **Physical Characteristics** — Defines the mechanical and electrical specifications of interfaces and transmission media (cables, connectors, signal levels).
- **Representation of Bits** — Defines how `0`s and `1`s are converted into electrical or optical signals.
- **Data Rate & Synchronization** — Determines the transmission speed (bits per second) and clock synchronization between sender and receiver.
- **Physical Topology & Transmission Mode** — Defines how devices are physically connected (bus, star, mesh) and the direction of transmission (simplex, half-duplex, full-duplex).
